senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="M01727">same</cite> <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 4:7">Targ. Ruth IV, 7</cite>; a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:12">Snh. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ בעלמא</he> a mere usage (is incidentally recorded in the Bible, not meant as a law).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>דלא לשתני ממ׳</he> in order not to depart from the common custom; <he>דלישתנו ממ׳</he> intimating that they will be treated differently from the common usage (as a disgrace).

<cite ref="Niddah 66a:59">Nidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>אמינא לך איסורא ואת אמרת מ׳</he> I speak of a legal prohibition, and you quote a usage; <cite ref="Yevamot 13b:20">Yeb. 13ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:20">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ</cite> <he>מנהגו מנהגיה</he>, v. <cite ref="E00068"><he>הֲגִי</he></cite>
